metadata.case_name: SINGH BAL WINDER v. IWS WASTE MANAGEMENT CO LTD FORMERLY KNOWN AS FOOK WOO WASTE PAPER CO LTD

plaintiff.occupation_before: lorry driver employed by the defendant

injuries.description: multiple disc desiccation and bulging (generalized posterior prolapse) discs at L3‑4, L4‑5; operative removal at L3/4 and L4/5
source: a MRI was performed on 10 April 2012 which showed “multiple disc desiccation” and “bulging (generalized posterior prolapse) discs at L3‑4, L4‑5”.

An operation was performed on 24 August 2012. Intra-operative finding was “bulging disc L3/4 and L4/5” and the surgical procedure of “left side L3/4 laminotomy and annulotomy and discectomy L3/4; left side L4/5 laminotomy, annulotomy and discectomy L4/5” was performed.

“it is likely that Mr. Singh suffered from significant and at least moderate degree of soft tissue injury to his back, probably causing / significantly aggravating disc protrusions in the lower back, causing persistent pain and impairment in the back…rather than developing such back pain coincidentally after the subject accident as a result of natural degeneration.”
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

source: there is no dispute between the orthopaedics experts (Dr. Lam Chi Keung, Johnson, for the plaintiff and Dr. Chun Siu Yeung for the defendant) that the plaintiff has pre-existing back degeneration
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: history of left ankle fracture with resulting osteoarthritis
source: The plaintiff also has a history of left ankle fracture with resulting osteoarthritis.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

manifestations.description: persistent pain and impairment in the back
pain (of moderate to severe degree) which disturbed his sleep and not controlled by medications since the accident (i.e. for more than 6 years).
burning pain in the back of thigh and calf when depressing the clutch of the lorry

treatments_received: attended A&E at United Christian Hospital (UCH) on 4 December 2011
left side L3/4 laminotomy and annulotomy and discectomy L3/4; left side L4/5 laminotomy, annulotomy and discectomy L4/5 (operation on 24 August 2012)
post-operative physiotherapy between 12 October 2012 and 2 April 2013
follow-ups in the UCH orthopaedics out-patient clinic until 20 November 2013
